intro: Mining dominates Mongolia's economy, with most exports going to China.

chapters.title: Mining
text: Oyu Tolgoi is one of the world's largest copper and gold mines, and coal is shipped to China.

chapters.title: Herding
text: Cashmere from Mongolian goats is among the finest in the world.
